members.M2: TypeCollector..ctor(Compilation, AnalyzerOptions, ReferenceSymbols, ITypeSymbol, Action<Diagnostic>?, CancellationToken)

tests.pins: GetObjectInfo returns object info for int-key and map-mode [MessagePackObject] classes so CollectObject registers a formatter that compiles, and reports a MsgPack diagnostic at an unattributed public property's identifier.

The TypeCollector constructor accepts [MessagePackObject] structs as targets (so Collect yields a model and a formatter) and, for inaccessible types, reports MsgPack012 at the type identifier and leaves targetType null so Collect returns no formatter.
